features: [One Powerbank. Every Way to Charge.]:Meet Odin Pro — a 10,000mAh Qi2.2 magnetic wireless powerbank with 25W wireless and 45W wired fast charging. Snap it on for fast wireless charging or use the built-in USB-C cable when you need maximum power.

[Snap. Charge. Go.]:25W Qi2.2 Magnetic Wireless Charging Experience next-generation magnetic wireless charging with up to 25W output. Compatible iPhones and Pixels can charge up to 50% in around 30 minutes wirelessly.

[45W Power. Built Right In]:Fast Wired Charging Without the Extra Cable The built-in USB-C cable delivers up to 45W PD output, giving your iPhone, Samsung and Pixel devices high-speed wired charging whenever you need it.

[Know Your Power. At a Glance.]:TFT Display + Built-in Stand Keep an eye on your remaining battery with the TFT digital display, while the built-in stand lets you keep your phone upright as you charge.

[Made for Your Devices. Ready for Your Day.]:One Powerbank. Multiple Devices. Odin Pro works with the latest iPhones, Samsung Galaxy devices, Pixels and AirPods Pro, with up to 45W PPS charging for Samsung Super Fast Charging 2.0.
